messages:
maria: Uploaded the raw checkpoint to s3://redwood-private/models/crest-11b/raw/175215 — need packaging + tokenizer sanity check. @alex can you take this?
alex: On it. Quick q: what tensor-parallel layout was used when saving? interleaved or contiguous per-rank?
maria: Training used TP=2 and saved contiguous (per-rank) tensors. Weights are fp16. Tokenizer has a custom vocab and we added a pad token `<|pad|>` at id=2, but the tokenizer.json in the artifact is missing the `special_tokens_map` entry. Also noticed trailing null bytes in tokenizer.json (causes HF loader to choke).
devon: For packaging we typically do: re-shard -> convert to safetensors -> name shards for serving layout. What's the target shard count for serving? and do we need an interleaved layout for TP>1?
maria: Target is 8 shards for serving. Runtime expects interleaved TP layout for TP>1. Since this is TP=2 contiguous, we need a re-shard/reshape step that produces interleaved tensors for the runtime. Naming convention: /models/crest-11b/v2/weights/00000-of-00008-fp16.safetensors (etc). I'll paste the re-shard command I used locally:

```bash
python packaging/re_shard.py \
  --input s3://redwood-private/models/crest-11b/raw/175215/ \
  --out s3://redwood-private/models/crest-11b/v2/weights/ \
  --from-tp 2 --to-shards 8 --layout interleaved
```

Note: also run `sed -i 's/\\x00//g' tokenizer.json` to strip nulls before upload.
alex: quick question — tokenizer.json has pad_token_id=2 but the model config still has pad_token_id=1. Which is canonical?
maria: Canonical is tokenizer.json. I patched the model config locally to match tokenizer but didn't push. I'll update config in the artifact before you run the packaging. Also remove trailing nulls as mentioned.
alex: Ok re-sharding job started. ETA ~25m. Pinging infra for CI job to run packaging.
infra-bot: packaging job #829 submitted by alex — logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/829 :package:
alex: packaging failed at re-sharder: OOM on node-3 while trying to load full model (CUDA OOM allocating 512MiB).
devon: Try the streaming re-sharder (reads tensors in slices, doesn't materialize full model). Use `--stream` and set CHUNK_SIZE smaller.
alex: Re-run with `--stream --chunk-size 64MB` — succeeded. Uploaded shards to s3://redwood-private/models/crest-11b/v2/weights/: 00000-of-00008-fp16.safetensors ... 00007-of-00008-fp16.safetensors. Also pushed cleaned tokenizer.json and updated model_config.json. @maria can you run the smoke tokenization + forward tests?
maria: Running smoke tests now (`runtests/tokenizer_smoke.py` + `runtests/forward_smoke.py`). Noted one edge-case where leading BOM in a few strings caused tokenization mismatch; patched tokenizer pre-processing.
maria: Smoke tests passed. Model looks good for staging. I'll open a PR to pin v2 in the model catalog and schedule a canary deploy tomorrow morning. :rocket:
